request.style: English, heavy blues rock, powerful male vocal, distorted guitars, Hammond organ, bass, pounding drums, building tension, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They baked the bricks and they burned them hard
They mixed the tar in the city yard
One people with one language, one dream in every eye
We'll build ourselves a tower that will scrape against the sky

[Chorus]
Come, let us build ourselves a city
With a tower that reaches to the heavens
And make a name for ourselves
Make a name, make a name for ourselves

[Verse]
Higher went the scaffolding, higher went the pride
Nothing we set our minds to could be denied
But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower
That the children of man were building in their hour

[Chorus]
Come, let us build ourselves a city
With a tower that reaches to the heavens
And make a name for ourselves
Make a name, make a name for ourselves

[Bridge]
Then the words began to tangle and the voices turned to noise
The foreman couldn't call them and the builders lost their poise
So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of the whole earth
And they stopped building the city

[Outro]
A name for ourselves
It was never ours to make
